heading: INT. PAWNSHOP INSIDE DEFUNCT AQUARIUM - NIGHT

units.text: INT. PAWNSHOP INSIDE DEFUNCT AQUARIUM - NIGHT
A pawnshop built into the old shark tank.
The glass walls are cracked and green with algae.
Guitars hang where the hammerheads once circled.
A neon sign buzzes: "CASH FOR ANYTHING."
SAL "THE EEL" DiMARCO, sixties, slick-haired, in a shiny shirt open to the chest, sits behind a counter counting bills.
His smile never reaches his eyes.
FRANCESCA OYELOWO, thirties, a detective in a navy raincoat, comes in shaking water off her umbrella.
She looks around the tank the way a diver might.
We're closed.
units.name: SAL

units.text: The door was open.
units.name: FRANCESCA

units.text: Doors do that.
units.name: SAL

units.text: She walks the length of the counter.
She picks up a ukulele, plucks one string, puts it down.
Nice acoustics.
units.name: FRANCESCA

units.text: Used to be a tank for sharks. Now it's a tank for sharks.
units.name: SAL

units.text: Cute.
units.name: FRANCESCA

units.text: You hear that, boys? The lady thinks I'm cute.
units.name: SAL
paren: to the room, though nobody else is there

units.text: Mr. DiMarco, a necklace went missing from the Hartwell estate on Tuesday. Emerald, platinum chain. It turned up on your ledger on Wednesday.
units.name: FRANCESCA

units.text: Ledger says a lot of things.
units.name: SAL

units.text: It says you paid four hundred dollars.
units.name: FRANCESCA

units.text: Charity.
units.name: SAL

units.text: It says you paid it to a boy named Teddy Hartwell. Age nine.
units.name: FRANCESCA

units.text: Sal sets down the bills.
The neon buzzes louder.
Kids lie.
units.name: SAL

units.text: Teddy was telling the truth. He wanted to buy his mother a birthday present. He sold her own necklace to get it.
units.name: FRANCESCA

units.text: Then it's a sad story.
units.name: SAL

units.text: It's a sad story with a felony in it.
units.name: FRANCESCA

units.text: Sal slides one hand beneath the counter.
Francesca's own hand goes to her coat.
You're brave, coming in here alone.
units.name: SAL

units.text: I'm not alone.
units.name: FRANCESCA

units.text: Who's with you?
units.name: SAL

units.text: She nods toward the cracked glass behind him.
Through the algae, shapes move in the dark, a dozen uniforms.
Eel's finally out of the water.
units.name: SAL
